outcome: ADR 0095 implemented, installed on the household installation and measured. After a Stop Monitoring or Resume edit the panel now patches its catalog from a one-step delta on the subscription event: zero catalog pages were requested in all six live cycles, against 63 pages (1.81 s median) before. The median time from the confirm click to a settled panel fell from 5.31 s to 3.24 s. The save itself is unchanged at about 3 s, as expected.

browser_acceptance.environment: The WSL Chromium builds that Playwright 1.57 installs produce no animation frames on this machine (requestAnimationFrame never fires, identically for HEAD and the working tree), so Playwright's actionability checks never pass there; the full Chromium build dumps core at startup. Firefox for Playwright needs newer NSS libraries than this Ubuntu 24.04 has. The fixture sweep therefore ran on Windows with the installed Chrome through the new --browser-channel option; the live real-HA sweep could not run on either side.
